title: Corrected-demand audited convergence paths
description: Plot-ready audit trajectories for the 21 completed factorial branches that did not pass and the three reported accepted equilibria E1-E3.

metric.definition: Maximum normalized unilateral profit gain in the saved one-start, common-frozen, zero-proximal six-player audit.
metric.criterion: All six one-start solves successful and maximum normalized relative gain <= 1%.

accounting.note: E2 and E3 are accepted factorial branches. E1 is the accepted path from the earlier 3x3 alpha=0.30 experiment. The factorial branch that failed during sweep 12 is retained under excluded_partial_runs and is not counted among the 24 plotting paths.
accounting.data_quality_note: best_valid_point is recomputed using only audits in which all six solves succeeded. This matters for one no-pass branch whose status selected a sub-1% audit with a failed solve.
